meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 分析指定目录，判断它是否属于 Karpathy 风格的 LLM wiki 知识库（原始资料+wiki 文档+schema 文件）。若是，提取文章与实体、补全隐含联系、按主题归类，生成交互式知识图谱，并自动打开可视化仪表盘。
howto.when: 当用户请求分析一个 Karpathy 风格的 LLM wiki 目录，或直接把目录路径交给它让其理解并生成图谱时触发。

say.note: 会执行完整流程并打开仪表盘。

say.text: 检查当前目录是不是 Karpathy 风格的 LLM wiki，是就处理一下。
say.note: 格式不符时会告诉你缺少什么。

say.text: 把 /data/wiki 这个 wiki 知识库按主题和关系整理成可视化图。
say.note: 可直接触发技能，无需额外解释。

howto.what_en: Analyze a directory to determine if it matches the Karpathy-style LLM wiki pattern (raw sources, wiki markdown, schema). If yes, extract articles/entities, infer implicit links, cluster topics, and produce an interactive graph dashboard, auto-launching visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze a Karpathy-style LLM wiki directory, or hands it a path to understand and graph.

say_en.text: Analyze ~/notes/llm-wiki and output the knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Runs the full pipeline and opens the dashboard.

say_en.text: Check if the current directory is a Karpathy wiki; if so, process it.
say_en.note: If invalid, it will tell you what is missing.

say_en.text: Turn the wiki in /data/wiki into a visual map by topics and links.
say_en.note: Works directly with a Karpathy-style wiki directory.
